features.summary: The configuration file itself: schema v1, `version`, `$schema` and the `experimental` opt-in
HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2 and h2c proxying: listeners, routes and rules, services, defaults, manual certificates, client IP trust, the v0.1 middlewares
Access log, Prometheus metrics and OpenTelemetry traces
The file provider with watching, reload and the last-known-good copy
The Docker provider with `rdock.*` and Traefik labels and zero-config mode
Automatic certificates over ACME (HTTP-01, TLS-ALPN-01, DNS-01), ARI renewal and the local CA
Health checks, passive ejection, retries, sticky sessions, splits, mirroring, limits, client certificates, JWT and gRPC-Web
The admin API under `/api/v1`, the configuration API and the local CLI
Dashboard users, second factors, sessions, API tokens and the audit log
The embedded dashboard
The Docker Swarm provider
TCP routes: SNI routing, TLS passthrough and termination, STARTTLS
Static files from ReverseDock's own file system (`type: static`)
DNS-01 adapters (Cloudflare, RFC 2136, Route 53, Google Cloud DNS, Azure DNS, deSEC, webhook)
The Kubernetes Gateway API controller (the conformance profiles it passes)
Alert channels (Slack, Discord, webhooks, SMTP) and alert rules
PROXY protocol v1/v2 from trusted sources and to TCP backends
Translation of Kubernetes Ingress objects and ingress-nginx annotations
Services that answer a fixed status (`respond`)
The RFC 9111 HTTP cache in memory or on disk, with purge by URL and tag
Native Rust plugins compiled into your own binary (`type: plugin`, the `rdock-plugin-api` SDK)
Out-of-process agents such as a WAF (`type: agent`)
Consumers, API keys, quotas, usage metering and limits keyed by consumer group
OpenID Connect login for browsers (`type: oidc`)
Request validation against JSON Schema and OpenAPI, header and JSON Patch transformation, problem-details answers
Holding the whole request body before it is forwarded (`type: hold_body`)
Verifying Cloudflare Access tokens (`type: cloudflare_access`)
UDP listeners, routes and services
Secrets read from Vault or OpenBao (`${vault:…}` references)
Latency-aware balancing (`peak_ewma`), outlier detection, the long form of slow start, priority tiers, zones and per-try timeouts
JA4 and JA3 TLS client fingerprints
GeoIP databases for country, continent and ASN rules
Abuse counters and bans (`type: abuse`)
Identity rules on client certificates and SPIFFE IDs
Replacing the binary in place by handing the listeners over (`rdock upgrade`)
A cluster with a control plane, staged rollout and shared certificates (`rdock control`)
Rate limits and quotas shared between the instances of a cluster (`scope: cluster`)
Adaptive concurrency limits and load shedding by priority class (`type: admission`)
Tenants of the admin API
Listener socket and HTTP/2 options, the TLS handshake bound, shared TLS session resumption and runtime threads
The Go client of the admin API (`clients/go`, generated; not tagged yet)
The Terraform and OpenTofu provider (`clients/terraform`; not published yet)
Sandboxed WebAssembly plugins (`type: wasm`); the host ABI is `0.x`
HTTP/3 over QUIC on `https` listeners (`http3.enabled`)
